description: CoverWise full-stack monitoring — Prometheus infrastructure metrics + analytics event dashboard

panels.description: CPU utilization — requires Cloud Run managed Prometheus scraping or Cloud Monitoring datasource. The app's /metrics endpoint does NOT export CPU. To populate, add Cloud Monitoring as a datasource and query 'container/cpu/utilization' from 'cloud-monitoring' type, or configure your Prometheus server to also scrape Cloud Run /metricss (stackdriver metrics).
panels.title: CPU (via Cloud Mointoring)

panels.description: Memory utilization — requires Cloud Run managed Prometheus scraping or Cloud Monitoring datasource. The app's /metrics endpoint does NOT export memory. To populate, add Cloud Monitoring as a datasource and query 'container/memory/utilization' from 'cloud-monitoring' type, or configure your Prometheus server to also scrape Cloud Run /metricss (stackdriver metrics).
